seoTitle: Spin the Wheel - Custom Random Name Picker
metaDescription: Free online Spin the Wheel generator. Create custom wheels to randomly pick names, raffle winners, or make group decisions instantly.
intro: Need to draw a raffle winner, assign classroom chores, or pick a restaurant? Our free custom Spin the Wheel tool lets you input your own options for a fun, fair, and visual random selection.
whatIs: The Spin the Wheel tool is a highly customizable random selection generator. It allows users to input any number of text options (names, prizes, choices) which are then visually mapped onto slices of a digital spinning wheel.
howToUse: Type your options into the input text box, putting each option on a new line.
The wheel will automatically update to show your custom slices.
Click the center of the wheel to spin.
A winner is randomly selected when the wheel stops.
howItWorks: The tool divides 360 degrees equally by the number of inputs you provide. When you click spin, it generates a random rotation angle using browser math functions, animates the spin, and calculates which slice stopped at the top indicator.
workedExample: You enter three names: Alice, Bob, Charlie. The wheel creates three 120-degree slices. You spin. The math engine picks an angle of 980 degrees. The wheel spins and lands on Bob. Bob is the winner.
resultInterpretation: The selected slice is the completely random, objective winner. This is the fairest way to make a choice when multiple people have competing interests.
useCases: Teachers & Classrooms: Randomly calling on students without showing bias.
Giveaways & Raffles: Selecting a winner live on stream from a list of commenters.
Team Management: Randomly assigning the daily 'scrum master' or meeting note-taker.
tipsAndLimitations: You can enter the same option multiple times to give it a higher probability of winning (e.g., entering 'Pizza' twice and 'Burgers' once gives Pizza a 66% chance).
Extremely large lists (e.g., 500 names) will result in very thin slices that may be hard to read on mobile devices.

faq.question: Can I remove a winner after they are chosen?
faq.answer: Yes! Most users delete the winning name from the text box after a spin so they are not selected twice during classroom activities or multi-prize raffles.

faq.question: Are all slices equal?
faq.answer: Yes, if you enter 5 unique items, the algorithm gives each item exactly a 20% chance of being selected.

cta: Create your custom wheel and spin!
disclaimer: Tool utilizes browser-level pseudo-randomness. Designed for casual giveaways and entertainment, not regulated gambling or sweepstakes.
